note: The script asks for the hook question, one name super, two key-word moments and one top text, so 5 graphics and the end card. Elias's profile and photos are footage, not graphics.

mg.title: Hook question
mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: What happens after surgery?
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:05. Keep it inside the frame: nothing cut off at the edges.

mg.title: Name super
mg.use: Put it on 1 s into the row for 2 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Large, first name only.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words one at a time as she says them, top band: A photo / A quote / A note.
mg.use: Each word lands on hers, after the name super is gone. One text at a time.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words one at a time as she says them, top band: Print them out / Forward them / Share them.
mg.use: Each line lands on her words near the end of the row. Captions stay on.

mg.title: Top text

text.main: It's actually a moment of connection

mg.cue: Top text as she says it, 3 s, top band: It's actually a moment of connection.
mg.use: Put it on when she says it. Hold 3 s. Keep it inside the frame.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: watsi.org, all lowercase, Lato, navy #2E2844. One line. Nothing else.
mg.src: Watsi's own end card words from the script (watsi.org, the Who Gives close, or the Watsi x AYH lines). Watsi's scripts say no logo lockup. Source: endcards/index.json, 6 Oct 2026.
mg.use: This is the end card. Put it right after “Watsi.” and hold it to the end. No logo or corner bug anywhere before it.
